data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding reduced between 31 Dec 2022 and 31 Dec 2023 (from 755.050m to 618.180m USD). The report does not provide an explicit single-line gross prioryearonly movement (gross PYD) figure; movements are presented across the technical provisions reconciliation and in the claims development table. The reduction in overall reserves appears driven by favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries, but a gross prioryearonly quantification is not explicitly stated.
raw_causal_phrases: The provision for claims comprises amounts set aside for reported claims and incurred but not reported ('IBNR').
Adjustments to the amounts of claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the financial statements for the period in which the adjustments are made.
The directors consider that the provisions for gross claims and related reinsurance recoveries are fairly stated on the basis of the information currently available to them.
Claims development is expected when the underwriting year is as an early stage of development as the premiums to which the claims relate are earned.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, prior-year column). No explicit Gross prior-year-only reserve movement (PYD) amount is given in the notes or narrative. A gross claims development table is present but formatting in the source made precise diagonal extraction error-prone; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null. Overall gross claims outstanding decreased materially (755.050k -> 618.180k USD) but that total movement includes current-year development and foreign exchange revaluations; it is not a pure prior-year-only PYD figure per the extraction rules.
